prompts.A:
ONE original square 1024x1024 premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of atlas.
ANATOMY: Atlas in documented bent-knees/bent-back male human form supporting a celestial globe on shoulders; two arms two legs, beard editorial, fully opaque plain brown tunic and trousers [atlas-c09]
MOMENT: Atlas braces bent knee on rock, shoulders directly under enormous plain dark star-dotted celestial sphere, hands grip underside and face strains toward camera.
POWER: Bears massive weight of heavens, strains and shifts upward; celestial sphere has engraved simple star dots without writing, no Earth map or landmass globe [atlas-c01, atlas-c09, atlas-c13]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, subject dominant at 200px; tight imposing frame but full identifying attributes readable; source scale only, not an invented giant.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one strong natural sunset or moon key light, antique gold and dark walnut shadows, tangible physical dust or spray only.
SURFACE: tactile fur or feathers, aged metal, rough stone, fully opaque woven clothing wherever humanoid.
SETTING: Rocky Hesperides terrain and night sky, source region context [atlas-c04, atlas-c24]
MOOD: overwhelming active mythological presence, solemn courage for divine subjects, never cute, ordinary passive person or decorative statue.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no letters, writing, pseudo-glyphs, signs, symbols resembling script on ANY surfaces; NO logo/signature/border/watermark; no borrowed film/game/comic/anime design; no extra anatomy. Full opaque torso covering for humanoids, no nudity or sexualization, no gore, blood, harmed people or victims. No generic aura, neon outlines, runes, energy ribbons or ungrounded magic. Cloth and jewelry plain and unmarked. He supports heaven/celestial globe NOT planet Earth. No map/constellation glyphs/text. All torso opaque clothing, no bare chest, no extra arms or spheres.
